queries.name: Frozen packet connects failure, feedback, and baseline
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Packet {owner_id:$owner})-[:INCLUDES]->(c:Call) MATCH (f:Feedback {owner_id:$owner})-[:ABOUT]->(c) MATCH (p)-[:BASED_ON]->(v:Version) RETURN p.packet_id AS packet, c.call_id AS call, f.feedback_id AS feedback, v.version_id AS baseline

queries.name: Comparison links both versions and execution calls
queries.cypher: MATCH (e:Evaluation {owner_id:$owner})-[:COMPARES]->(v:Version) OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:RAN]->(c:Call) RETURN e.evaluation_id AS evaluation, v.version_id AS version, collect(DISTINCT c.call_id) AS calls

queries.name: Owner decisions and final stable pointer
queries.cypher: MATCH (a:Application {owner_id:$owner,application:$app})-[:STABLE]->(s:Version) MATCH (d:HumanDecision {owner_id:$owner,application:$app})-[:SELECTED]->(v:Version) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:EXPECTED_CURRENT]->(p:Version) RETURN d.decision_id AS decision,v.version_id AS selected,p.version_id AS expected_previous,s.version_id AS final_stable ORDER BY d.created_at
